CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SURYA KANT  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE NONGMEIKAPAM KOTISWAR SINGH
For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Rameshwar Prasad Goyal, AOR

For Respondent(s) : Mr. Arup Banerjee, AOR  Mr. Priyanshu Raj, Adv.
 Mr. D.D. Sharma, Adv.
 Mr. Rajiv Agnihotri, Adv.
 Mr. Vishnu Sharma, AOR
UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R 1.

This petition has been filed challenging the order dated 17.12.2020 passed by the Jharkhand High Court granting bail to respondent No.2, who is an accused in FIR No. 08/2020 registered under Sections 498A/306/34 IPC at Police Station Pirtand, District Giridih.
It may be mentioned that respondent No.2-accused is the husband of deceased-Rita Devi.
It further appears that after investigation, chargesheet under Sections 498A/306/34 IPC was filed.
Thereafter, respondent No.2 applied for regular bail, which was granted by the High Court vide impugned order.

The complainant 16:11:40 IST Reason:
is before us challenging that order.

sentences.text: 2. Notice in this case was issued on 12.04.2021.
This matter has unfortunately been listed after more than 4 years.
Meanwhile, the details regarding pending trial were obtained.
It reveals that respondent No.2 was declared juvenile and the Juvenile Justice Board through a recent order dated 05.03.2025 has acquitted him.
3. Though, we do not want to make any any observations causing prejudice to respondent No.2, it seems strange as to how a married person, apparently major, was declared juvenile.
Be that as it may, liberty is granted to the petitioner-complainant to challenge the order dated 05.03.2025 before an appropriate forum.
He shall also be at liberty to question the declaration granted in favour of respondent No.2, being a juvenile.
The concerned court shall examine both the aspects, namely, juvenility and acquittal in accordance with law.

4. If the complainant fails to take any action in the matter, the Member Secretary of the Jharkhand State Legal Services Authority is directed to examine the matter and if need be, the Legal Services Authority will take up the cause of the victim.
The Registry is directed to send a copy of this order to the Member Secretary of the Jharkhand State Legal Services Authority.
A copy of this order shall also be sent to the Secretary, Supreme Court Legal Services Authority for taking up the matter with the State Legal Services Authority for appropriate action.
5. The Special Leave Petition stands disposed of, in the above terms.
6. Pending application(s), if any, shall also stand disposed of.

(NITIN TALREJA) (PREETHI T.C.)
